_comment: CONTROL for wolfrun_pump_exact_lethal: the same board with the opponent at 10. The most the Wolf Run can
pump is X = 4 (the five OTHER mana sources pay {4}{R}{G}; the land's own {C} cannot), so Avenger swings for
9 on T6 -- one short -- and the kill is T7. A T6 here would mean the pump was over-credited (the land
paying toward its own activation, or the X costed without its {R}{G}).
